VDA_rent_prices.source_basis: NT agentūrų ir internetinių portalų nuomos kainos

geography_options.C: 10 apskričių tikras agregatas iš savivaldybių lygmens duomenų

required_fields_not_yet_validated.rent: WAITING_PUBLICATION_GRADE_10_COUNTY_PRIVATE_RENT_LAYER; public search-index route closed at 9/10 N>=5

notes: Apskričių atlyginimų serija apima visus darbuotojus, ne tik 25–30 m.; nepublikuoti kaip tiesioginio jaunimo pajamų rodiklio.
VDA oficiali pirkimo kainų serija neturi 10 apskričių aprėpties.
VDA oficiali nuomos serija apima tik 5 didžiųjų miestų savivaldybes.
Apskrities centro duomenų negalima vadinti apskrities vidurkiu.
Live/main nekeisti, kol nepasirinkta ir neužpildyta pilna geografinė metodika.
Aruodas 2025-12 benchmark: 1-room offer averages were Vilnius 484 EUR/month, Kaunas 379, Klaipėda 371; use only for rent-method validation, not as county values.
VDA/RC 1 km apartment-purchase grid (dataset 2559) is QA/diagnostic only and must not be used as the main 10-county sale-price layer.
Smart Continent BI_3 reconstructed rent is QA/diagnostic only and must not be used as the main private-rent layer.
No county-center substitution: city values cannot be relabeled as county values.
All outgoing emails, external requests and forms must be shown to the owner before sending.
Aruodas/Skelbiu aggregate-data request has NOT been sent; any future portal request must be shown to the owner first and sent only after explicit approval.
Official VDA S7R280 2024 apartment sale benchmark is available for 6 city municipalities + Lithuania only; it is validation, not a 10-county layer.
Smart Continent BI_1 is exactly generic housing EUR/m² divided by monthly net VDU; it contains no independent apartment-only price signal.
Skelbiu.lt 2025 historical search-index county sample reaches N>=5 in 9/10 counties; Tauragės remains N=2. Route is research/QA only and fails publication gate.
Search-index observations are not a complete portal export even when N>=5; sample thresholds are minimum QA rules, not proof of full market representativeness.
Aruodas 2025 1-room monthly asking-rent benchmark is now complete for Vilnius, Kaunas and Klaipėda (12 months each) via hidden comparison-table values plus direct archived reports.

Cross-portal QA shows Skelbiu search-index medians below Aruodas annual monthly-average benchmarks by about 25.3% in Vilnius, 8.8% in Kaunas and 7.2% in Klaipėda; do not use these gaps as calibration factors.
Official data.gov.lt metadata for dataset 2559 explicitly says only single-object apartment purchase transactions are included; multi-object transactions are excluded.
Final publication target is now period-aligned to 2025 sale + 2025 rent + 2025-11 income where possible; 2024 sale is fallback only.
Official VDA S7R280 2025 apartment benchmark: Lithuania 1880.13 EUR/m², with six city municipalities available; this remains validation only, not a 10-county layer.
Registrų centro 2025 full-year control is approximately 37.1k apartment sales nationally.
Strategy changed on 2026-10-02: a clearly labelled preliminary v0.1 may be shown before strict final data gates pass; strict v1.0 validation remains unchanged.
Preliminary sale proxy uses Smart Continent 2024 generic-housing transaction prices calibrated to VDA S7R280 2025 apartment prices in six cities; rural transfer remains unvalidated.
Preliminary v0.1 includes a sensitivity band rather than presenting the central estimate as exact.

Dual-mode policy: STRICT/v1.0 remains validated_publication_ready=false; PRELIMINARY/v0.1 is allowed in feature/preview only with explicit OFFICIAL / MODELLED / PRELIMINARY / TO_BE_REFINED labels. Main/live remains locked.

sale_layer.main_source_target: Registrų centras official 2025 apartment transaction aggregate/anonymized layer; 2024 only as explicitly labelled fallback
sale_layer.geography_requirement: 60 municipalities -> 10 counties, or direct 10-county aggregate with documented method
sale_layer.current_grid_dataset: VDA / Registrų centras 1x1 km apartment purchase transaction grid (dataset 2559)
sale_layer.reason: 2024 snapshot covers only 33 municipalities / 8 counties and 516 transactions; it is a narrow subset of the full apartment market and cannot support the main 10-county sale-price layer.
sale_layer.rc_request_status: 2024 request sent 2026-10-01; awaiting reply. 2025 follow-up NOT SENT and requires owner approval.
sale_layer.note: Do not aggregate the 1 km grid into the publication sale layer.
sale_layer.smart_continent_bi1_formula: BI_1 = generic housing EUR/m² / monthly net VDU exactly for all 60 municipalities
sale_layer.official_vda_validation: S7R280 2025 apartment EUR/m² verified for 6 city municipalities + Lithuania

dataset_2559_documented_selection.rule: Dataset explicitly excludes multi-object purchase transactions and includes only transactions where one object was acquired.
dataset_2559_documented_selection.examples_excluded: apartment + storage unit; apartment + land parcel
dataset_2559_documented_selection.implication: By official definition this is a selected subset of the apartment market and cannot be treated as a full-market transaction layer.

sale_layer.period_alignment_reason: 2025 sale is preferred because rent is 2025 and income is 2025-11; official VDA S7R280 2025 is already available.

income_layer.source: Sodra open data: Vidutinės apdraustųjų pajamos
income_layer.note: Municipality income data are available in Sodra open-data exports; national 25–30 benchmark already verified.

rent_layer.main_target: 2025 private long-term 1-room apartment asking-rent layer covering all 10 counties
rent_layer.preferred_source_shape: direct county aggregates; alternatively complete municipality aggregates/raw listings with documented basket, duplicate handling and aggregation weights
rent_layer.official_validation: VDA S7R281 2025 official rent benchmark verified from ArcGIS FeatureServer for 5 largest cities
rent_layer.secondary_validation: Aruodas historical offer statistics for Vilnius, Kaunas, Klaipėda
rent_layer.reason: 60-municipality BI_3 series has unverified municipal estimation/basket/precision and implausibly low reconstructed rents in multiple municipalities.
rent_layer.portal_request_status: NOT_SENT; draft/request may be prepared only after showing exact text to owner and receiving explicit approval

search_index_county_sample.note: Direct listing-level county pooling avoids city=county substitution, but search-index is not a complete portal export and Tauragė remains N<5.

aruodas_2025_validation.method: 2025-01..09 from hidden prior-year comparison columns in 2026 same-month reports; 2025-10..12 direct archived reports

cross_portal_validation.note: Different portals and aggregation statistics; gaps are diagnostic only and must not be used as calibration factors.

calculation_layer.strict_default: requires publication_approved sale and rent layers
blockers: official RC/VDA 2025 actual-apartment transaction layer covering 60 municipalities / 10 counties (2024 only fallback)
2025 private long-term 1-room asking-rent layer covering all 10 counties

income_model_2025_11.note: Savivaldybių pajamų struktūra iš Sodra 2025-11 lentelės; jaunimo lygis modeliuotas nacionaliniu 25–30 / visų visą mėnesį dirbusių santykiu; apskrities svoris — savivaldybės apdraustųjų skaičius.

validation_benchmarks_sale_offer_or_mark.usage: validation only; final sale layer must use an official RC actual-apartment-transaction aggregate/anonymized source that passes the 60-municipality/10-county methodology gate. Dataset 2559 grid remains QA only.

preliminary_strategy.principle: Show the best currently supportable estimate, label uncertainty and replace provisional layers when better data arrive.

strict_v1_0.rule: Final v1.0 remains blocked until the official/validated 2025 apartment-sale layer and publication-grade 2025 1-room rent layer cover all 10 counties.

preliminary_v0_1.rule: Show the best currently supportable estimate, but mark every non-final layer and every composite result as preliminary/to be refined. No proxy may be described as official county apartment price or complete county rent market.
